not_issuing_blacklisted_extra_mint_recip.title: Deduction: unreturned extra-mint from the 2023 incident
not_issuing_blacklisted_extra_mint_recip.user_text: This exact amount was received from the 2023 extra-mint incident and was never returned. It is deducted from the claim, no ERC-20 tokens or vault shares are created for it, and it is retained in the 2050 premint reserve. The remainder of the claim, if any, is unaffected.

not_issuing_burn_or_inaccessible.title: Deduction: burn or inaccessible address
not_issuing_burn_or_inaccessible.user_text: This balance sits at a burn address or an address that is provably inaccessible. It is not issued on Ethereum and is retained in the 2050 premint reserve.

not_issuing_reported_wallet_theft_perpet.title: Deduction: reported wallet-theft proceeds
not_issuing_reported_wallet_theft_perpet.user_text: This exact amount was identified in an audited theft report as perpetrator proceeds. It is not issued on Ethereum and is retained in the 2050 premint reserve.

not_issuing_report_linked_theft_recipien.title: Deduction: report-linked theft recipient
not_issuing_report_linked_theft_recipien.user_text: This exact amount was linked by reviewed transaction evidence to reported theft proceeds. It is not issued on Ethereum and is retained in the 2050 premint reserve.

non_multisig_contract_recovery_custody.title: Routed to contract-recovery custody
non_multisig_contract_recovery_custody.user_text: This balance belongs to a reviewed smart contract. It is transferred to a segregated recovery custody address and released to a verified claimant in a later phase. It is not spendable as treasury money.

wone_reserve_custody.title: Routed to WONE reserve custody
wone_reserve_custody.user_text: The native ONE backing Wrapped ONE is migrated once to a dedicated reserve multisig. WONE holders will claim from that finite reserve in a later phase.

wone_priority_holder_redistribution.title: WONE reserve redistributed to qualified holders
wone_priority_holder_redistribution.user_text: This is a terminal source offset paired with WONE already included in qualified holder wallet rows. It has no recipient and does not create a second payout.

wone_reserve_remainder_retained_not_issu.title: WONE reserve remainder retained
wone_reserve_remainder_retained_not_issu.user_text: The WONE backing not allocated to the current qualified holder batch is not issued and is retained in the 2050 premint reserve.

not_issuing_historical_incident_retained.title: Deduction: historical incident retained balance
not_issuing_historical_incident_retained.user_text: This cutoff balance is within the reviewed retained cap from a historical unbacked-credit incident. It is not issued on the replacement chain and is retained in the 2050 premint reserve.

reviewed_contract_allocation_not_issued.title: Reviewed contract allocation not issued
reviewed_contract_allocation_not_issued.user_text: This reviewed genuine-contract allocation is not issued in the migration and is retained in the 2050 premint reserve.

next_stage_multisig_recovery.title: Next stage: reviewed multisig
next_stage_multisig_recovery.user_text: This reviewed multisig remains eligible for a later stage after a replacement Safe preserving the verified owners and threshold is approved.

next_stage_onewallet_recovery_multisig.title: Next stage: 1wallet recovery multisig
next_stage_onewallet_recovery_multisig.user_text: This reviewed 1wallet allocation remains eligible for a later stage after its recovery-multisig destination is approved.

exchange_requested_aggregate_reroute.title: Handled by exchange
exchange_requested_aggregate_reroute.user_text: This exchange-controlled wallet does not receive a direct same-address airdrop. Its entitlement is assigned to the exchange's approved aggregate destination, or remains on hold until that destination is approved.

layerzero_nativeoft_reconciliation_hold.title: Held: LayerZero NativeOFT reconciliation pending
layerzero_nativeoft_reconciliation_hold.user_text: This reserve backs cross-chain tokens. It stays on hold until the remote-chain supply and messages in flight are reconciled and a custody destination is approved.

contract_review.title: Held: smart contract, later phase
contract_review.user_text: This account is a smart contract. Contract balances are not delivered to the same address automatically; they are handled through a class-specific recovery process in a later phase.

deferred.title: Deferred: below the 1,000 ONE threshold
deferred.user_text: The total claim for this account is below the 1,000 ONE eligibility threshold, so it is not part of the prioritized distribution.

verified validator wrapper same-address.title: Verified validator account
verified validator wrapper same-address.user_text: This account carries Harmony validator data in its code field but was verified to be key-controlled. Its wallet tokens and vault shares are delivered to the same address.

explicit_governor_route.title: Vault governor pending approval
explicit_governor_route.user_text: The governor of this validator's vault is on hold until an approved Ethereum governor address is recorded.
